```{r}
#| label: setup
#| include: false
library(tidyverse)
library(broom)
library(scales)

set.seed(540)
```

## Data Load

```{r}
# Path is relative to this folder
marketing <- read_csv("../Claude Code/marketingcampaign.csv",
                      col_types = cols(
                        age = col_integer(),
                        gender = readr::col_factor(),
                        past_purchases = col_integer(),
                        campaign_variant = readr::col_factor(levels = c("A", "B", "C")),
                        ad_source = readr::col_factor(),
                        email_signup = col_logical(),
                        campaign_spend = col_double()
                      ))

marketing
``` 

## Quick Glance

```{r}
summary(marketing)
```

```{r}
marketing %>%
  count(gender, campaign_variant) %>%
  arrange(desc(n))
```

## Past Purchases (Question 1)

```{r}
# Distribution of past purchases
marketing %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = past_purchases)) +
  geom_histogram(binwidth = 3, fill = "#1f77b4", color = "white", boundary = 0) +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = seq(0, 100, 10)) +
  labs(x = "Past purchases (2 years)", y = "Customers", title = "Distribution of past purchases")
```

```{r}
# Average past purchases by demographic features
marketing %>%
  group_by(gender) %>%
  summarise(mean_past = mean(past_purchases), .groups = "drop")
```

```{r}
marketing %>%
  group_by(email_signup) %>%
  summarise(mean_past = mean(past_purchases), .groups = "drop")
```

### Poisson regression

```{r}
poisson_mod <- glm(past_purchases ~ age + gender + campaign_variant + ad_source + email_signup,
                   family = poisson(link = "log"),
                   data = marketing)

tidy_poisson <- tidy(poisson_mod, exponentiate = TRUE, conf.int = TRUE)
tidy_poisson
```

```{r}
tidy_poisson %>%
  filter(term == "age" | str_detect(term, "gender")) %>%
  mutate(label = case_when(
    term == "age" ~ "Age (per year)",
    term == "genderWoman" ~ "Gender: Woman vs Man",
    term == "genderNon-Binary" ~ "Gender: Non-Binary vs Man",
    term == "genderOther" ~ "Gender: Other vs Man",
    TRUE ~ term
  )) %>%
  select(label, estimate, conf.low, conf.high, p.value)
```

```{r}
# Model fit diagnostics
broom::glance(poisson_mod)
```

## Campaign Spend (Question 2)

```{r}
marketing %>%
  group_by(campaign_variant) %>%
  summarise(
    customers = n(),
    avg_spend = mean(campaign_spend),
    median_spend = median(campaign_spend)
  )
```

```{r}
marketing %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = campaign_variant, y = campaign_spend, fill = campaign_variant)) +
  geom_boxplot(alpha = 0.75) +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = dollar_format()) +
  labs(x = "Campaign variant", y = "Campaign spend (USD)", title = "Spend by campaign variant") +
  theme(legend.position = "none")
```

### Log-linear model for spend

```{r}
spend_mod <- lm(log1p(campaign_spend) ~ age + past_purchases + gender + campaign_variant + ad_source + email_signup,
                data = marketing)

tidy_spend <- tidy(spend_mod, conf.int = TRUE)
tidy_spend
```

```{r}
tidy_spend %>%
  filter(str_detect(term, "campaign_variant")) %>%
  mutate(variant = str_replace(term, "campaign_variant", "Variant ")) %>%
  select(variant, estimate, conf.low, conf.high, p.value)
```

```{r}
# Estimated spend for a typical customer (mean age/past purchases, most common categories)
Mode <- function(x) {
  ux <- unique(x)
  ux[which.max(tabulate(match(x, ux)))]
}

typical_customer <- tibble(
  age = mean(marketing$age),
  past_purchases = mean(marketing$past_purchases),
  gender = factor(Mode(marketing$gender), levels = levels(marketing$gender)),
  ad_source = factor(Mode(marketing$ad_source), levels = levels(marketing$ad_source)),
  email_signup = Mode(marketing$email_signup)
)

predict_typical <- function(variant) {
  new_data <- typical_customer %>%
    mutate(campaign_variant = factor(variant, levels = levels(marketing$campaign_variant)))
  pred_log <- predict(spend_mod, newdata = new_data)
  tibble(campaign_variant = variant, predicted_spend = expm1(pred_log))
}

map_dfr(levels(marketing$campaign_variant), predict_typical)
```

```{r}
broom::glance(spend_mod)
```
